deduplication_engine_representation.explanation: Multiple supplier feeds (e.g., Hotelbeds, Agoda Partner API, Viator, GetYourGuide, TBO Direct, WebBeds) for the exact same attraction or property are matched and unified into a single canonical product card. Users expand to see every supplier's live offer side by side.

component_hierarchy.name: NavigationHeader
component_hierarchy.description: Sticky top bar with TBO Optimization brand mark, Sightseeing/Hotels switcher, currency toggle (INR ₹ / USD $), demo data selector, and transparent backdrop blur.

component_hierarchy.name: SearchHeroBox
component_hierarchy.description: Tabbed dual-vertical search form with auto-suggest destinations (Agra, London, Paris, Dubai, Bali), dates picker, guest selector, and instant ranking triggers.

component_hierarchy.name: ConsolidatedListingCard
component_hierarchy.description: The central innovation component: Displays canonical product with deduplicated summary, explainable ranking pill ('#1 Ranked: Lowest combined price & 100% free cancellation'), thumbnail gallery, key differentiators chips, and expandable nested supplier matrix with instant side-by-side comparison modal trigger.

component_hierarchy.name: SupplierComparisonDrawerOrModal
component_hierarchy.description: Full side-by-side comparison grid matching 3-5 suppliers on all required parameters: room/ticket equivalence, base price + taxes, cancellation deadline, meal/transfer inclusions, refundability, and supplier reliability score. Flags 'Cheapest' and 'Best Terms' distinctively.

component_hierarchy.name: ExplainableRankingExplainer
component_hierarchy.description: Plain-language badge and popover explaining why a specific option is ranked first (e.g. 'Saved ₹2,450 vs Supplier B; 99.2% fulfillment SLA').

component_hierarchy.name: EnrichedProductDetail
component_hierarchy.description: Editorial layout for detail view: rich amenities, image carousel, supplier matrix folded into clean tabs, map location, and transparent supplier disclaimers (browse and compare only).

component_hierarchy.name: InnovexWatermark
component_hierarchy.description: Fixed bottom watermark reading 'INNOVEX' as mandated by problem statement.

accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens meet APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1. Primary text #1C1917 on #FAF7F2 is 13.8:1 contrast.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab indices, ARIA expand states for accordion supplier rows, modal focus traps.
accessibility.data_testid_convention: Every interactive control and metric cell has descriptive kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='supplier-compare-btn-viator', data-testid='tab-sightseeing', data-testid='ranking-reason-badge').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Follow the CSS entry /app/frontend/src/index.css with Playfair Display for headings and DM Sans for body.
2. Render the browse-and-compare experience without any checkout, user sign-in or payment barriers.

3. Seed rich realistic multi-supplier demo datasets for both verticals: (Hotels: Taj Lake Palace Udaipur, The Savoy London, Hotel Le Meurice Paris; Sightseeing: Taj Mahal Sunrise VIP Tour, London Eye & Thames River Cruise, Eiffel Tower Skip-the-line with Summit).
4. Highlight the deduplication technology: multiple suppliers (TBO Direct, Hotelbeds, Agoda Partner, Viator, GetYourGuide, TourCMS) consolidated into 1 parent listing card.
5. Clearly display the comparison panel with Best Price and Best Terms badges and explainable ranking justifications.
6. Include the INNOVEX watermark fixed at the bottom of every page.
7. Guarantee resilient fallback: if API or Mongo data is loading/unavailable, render the rich seeded client demo state seamlessly so the UI never displays blank errors.
